fields.statement: Every read and write of the call's own root goes through the projection, with the dry run's pending entries laid over it: workspace.model, entriesOfSet and changeSets lose their log branches, and the IndexPath and no-pending branches go from read.go's openReaderIn, change.go's runChangeShow and changeLsSets, ship.go's findShipTarget, slice.go's openSliceSource and run_model_cache.go:88, and run_milestone.go:179 reads its model from the projection instead of newModel over the disk log, and read.go:183, ship.go:398 and repair.go:161 take the open index from the projection (its store()) instead of calling index.Open on ctx.IndexPath
